title: Commit Result
description: One dispatched commit attempt. Every reported value is a claim: the Coordinator recomputes the staged set, the resulting SHA, and the remote refs before trusting it.
$comment: Strict structured output requires every property to appear in required at every level. Optional fields are nullable, never omitted from required. Omitting one makes the Codex backend fail with HTTP 400 before the model runs.

status.description: complete means every planned commit exists. refused means the secret scan or the staged-set check stopped the commit, which is a success of the gate and not an error. blocked means the attempt could not finish.

commits.description: Commits this attempt created, in order. Empty when status is refused.

stagedPaths.description: The staged set as observed by git diff --cached --name-only, not as intended. The Coordinator compares this against the approved product write set, which includes the changelog when the change is user-visible and never includes the Run's task files or its working documents.

refusedPaths.description: Paths the secret scan or the forbidden-path list removed from the staged set. Each one is reported to the user; none is dropped silently.

remoteRefsTouched.description: Must be empty. The committer has no authority to push, tag a remote, or move any remote ref; the push gate belongs to the user and the Coordinator. A non-empty array is a contract violation, not a report, and voids the attempt.

commands.description: Git invocations actually executed in this attempt, with their real exit codes.

needsDecision.description: True only when the blocker is a decision the Worker cannot resolve from the approved specification and the delivery manifest.

notes.description: Material deviations worth carrying to the push gate summary. Not a transcript.
